title: Terrell Owens, Royce Da 59, Claudia Jordan, & DJ Spinderella All React To Video Of Gillie Da Kid's Run-In With US Air Marshal At DFW
htmlContent:
Gillie Da Kid was confronted by a United States Air Marshal, who said the rapper became a podcaster and smelled like marijuana.

A United States marshal accused Gillie Da King of smelling like a weed during their encounter at the Dallas/Fort Worth airport on Tuesday afternoon.

Gillie shared an animated video of his interaction with the U.S. Marshal on Instagram. The video features the co-host of Million Dollaz Worth Of Game bickering with the US. Marshal, who wanted to search the rapper's bag for drugs.

“Plane full of white folks leaving Dallas and the only black man is ask does he have illegal narcotics in his bag,” the podcast host wrote on Instagram. “U pick the wrong ni$$a today buddy @americanair.”

“You picked me out for what?” Gillie asked. “For what? I’m probably the richest person on this plane. Get away from me, man.”

The U.S. Marshal replied, “You smell like marijuana. It’s illegal in Texas.”

The two continued to go back and forth with each other

Finally, the United States. Marshal stopped his questioning and left the podcaster alone.

Of course with Gillie being high profile his comment section filled up quickly. Hall of Fame wide receiver comment, "Wow."

Rapper Royce Da 59 asked, "Is he even on duty?"

DJ Spinderella shared, "Hmm me and my daughter was stopped a few days ago by the same guy."

Finally, Claudia Jordan shared that the same thing happened to her while traveling with Jet Blue.
